title: RFID Coin Tag / Token — Disc-Format ABS / PVC / Epoxy Transponder for Laundry, Gaming, Casino, Locker and Parking Token Programmes
summary: At BOM level, RFID coin tags are no-hole disc-format transponders in ABS / PVC / epoxy, die-cut to ±0.1 mm diameter tolerance across a 13-50 mm envelope, pairing a 125 kHz LF (EM4100 / EM4305 / T5577) or 13.56 MHz HF (NTAG 213 / 215 / 216 / 424 DNA, MIFARE Classic 1K, MIFARE Plus SE, MIFARE DESFire EV3) inlay with an impact-rated ABS housing validated per IEC 60068-2-32 Ea drop test. Unlike the keyring-holed coin keyfob, the RFID coin tag is the token-dispenser / coin-slot / casino-chip / arcade-bucket form — dropped into a mechanical acceptor, collected and recirculated across thousands of mechanical cycles per season.

brief.label: Form factor + diameter envelope
items: Round disc — 13 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 40 / 50 mm standard diameters at ±0.1 mm dimensional tolerance; custom diameter to the specific coin-slot acceptor dimension on request.
Thickness — 2 mm (13 mm), 2.5 mm (20 mm), 3 mm (25 / 30 mm), 3.5 mm (40 mm), 4 mm (50 mm) — profile matched to the mechanical acceptor depth.
No keyring hole (vs the rfid-coin-keyfob variant) — the disc is dropped into a coin-slot, dispenser barrel or arcade collection bucket rather than attached to a key-ring.

brief.label: Material + housing chemistry
items: Injection-moulded ABS (UL 94 94HB standard, UL 94 V-0 on request) — the workhorse housing for laundry / vending / gaming tokens where mechanical impact dominates the fatigue profile.
PVC disc variant — for stock-colour low-cost tokens in indoor consumer-promotional envelopes; not recommended for bucket-drop gaming or repeated-impact applications.
Epoxy-dome variant — clear-resin dome over a CMYK-printed face for premium casino-chip / branded-loyalty token aesthetics; ISO 4892-2 UV-stable outdoor grade on request.

brief.label: Air-interface envelope
items: 125 kHz LF per ISO/IEC 18000-2 — EM4100 (read-only UID) / EM4305 (re-writable tenant-reuse) / T5577 (multi-protocol programmable) for laundry / locker / legacy-HID-compatible rollouts.

13.56 MHz HF per ISO/IEC 14443-3 — NTAG 213 / 215 / 216 (NFC Forum Type 2 phone-tappable) / NTAG 424 DNA (SUN + CMAC anti-counterfeit) / MIFARE Classic 1K / MIFARE Plus SE / MIFARE DESFire EV3 (AES-128 stored-value).
Read range 0-30 mm at typical reader-coil tune; the ABS / PVC / epoxy housing is transparent to both LF 125 kHz and HF 13.56 MHz carriers.

brief.label: Mechanical impact + drop-test validation
items: ABS housing drop-test — 1.0 m onto steel plate per IEC 60068-2-32 Ea for 1,000 cycles without housing crack or chip-read failure; the bucket-drop fatigue profile of arcade / gaming applications.
Vibration + tumble — simulated mechanical-acceptor recirculation across 10,000+ cycles without read degradation.
Edge-chip survival — 90-degree rotation onto the edge at 1.0 m without loss of circular-antenna resonance (Q > 15).

brief.label: Laundry / locker-token posture
items: 20 mm or 25 mm ABS coin with EM4305 / T5577 LF chip for the legacy coin-operated washer / dryer acceptor envelope (Speed Queen / Huebsch / Dexter / Electrolux / Miele commercial-laundry machines).

Diameter tolerance ±0.1 mm confirmed against the specific coin-slot acceptance dimension before production; a 5-unit physical sample is dispatched for machine-fit validation before the full 500-50,000-piece run.

Ultrasonic-welded ABS + IP67 housing passes sweat / detergent / hot-wash-discharge exposure without chip failure; token recirculates through the collection bucket across a typical 3-5 year programme life.

brief.label: Gaming / arcade / vending-token posture
items: 25 / 30 mm ABS coin with NTAG 213 HF chip for arcade machine / amusement-park ride / skill-game token envelope; token recirculation through the dispenser + play + bucket-collection cycle runs 5,000-10,000 tokens × 100 cycles per season.
UL 94 V-0 ABS on request — for amusement-park / arcade venues subject to local fire-code flammability posture.
Laser-engraved sequential numbering — permanent UID + sequential-number marking for audit + loss-detection + token-recovery programmes.

brief.label: Casino-chip + gaming-commission audit posture
items: 40 mm ABS or epoxy-dome coin with NTAG 424 DNA SUN (CMAC replay-protection per NIST SP 800-38B) or MIFARE DESFire EV3 (AES-128 mutual authentication per NXP AN12343) for casino-table-chip rollouts.

Laser-engraved sequential chip number + venue logo / mint-mark visible on the rim — the casino-chip audit requires per-chip identification for the gaming-commission compliance audit (typical annual reconciliation: 100,000+ chips reconciled against database in 4 hours via RFID reader-walkthrough).

Anti-counterfeit — NTAG 424 DNA SUN message verified server-side before the chip balance or buy-in is honoured; replay-protection counter eliminates the CRYPTO-1 counterfeit-chip-with-inflated-balance attack vector that MIFARE Classic 1K is vulnerable to.

brief.label: Parking / locker-credit token posture
items: 30 mm ABS coin with MIFARE DESFire EV3 stored-value file (AES-128) for prepaid parking-credit / municipal-pool-locker / swim-centre access-credential rollouts.

Backend-authoritative balance — the token is the authenticated credential; the authoritative balance lives in the operator backend, with the DESFire EV3 value file holding a tamper-evident counter for reconciliation.
Revocation at the backend — a lost / stolen token is revoked server-side within seconds; the physical token on its own cannot be redeemed against a revoked UID.

brief.label: Chip-security + stored-value posture
items: MIFARE DESFire EV3 — AES-128 mutual authentication + value-file with tamper-evident counter + session keys per NXP AN12343 + key-diversification per NXP AN10922 — the correct chip for any monetary-value token programme.

MIFARE Classic 1K — retained only for drop-in parity with legacy HF reader estates; CRYPTO-1 has been publicly broken since Garcia et al. 2008, making the chip unsuitable for new stored-value deployments (inflated-balance counterfeit attack is trivially demonstrable with off-the-shelf tools).
NTAG 424 DNA — SUN message with CMAC per NIST SP 800-38B for anti-counterfeit + tap-authenticated ticketing; the backend verifies the SUN URL before honouring the token.

brief.label: Customisation + laser-engraving envelope
items: Colour library — 10 Pantone-matched stock shades + custom Pantone at 20,000+ piece MOQ.
Laser engraving — sequential numbering / venue logo / mint-mark / QR code / barcode, abrasion-resistant and chemical-resistant, no MOQ upcharge.
Screen-printing — 1-4 colour CMYK on one or both faces; pad-printing; digital inkjet; epoxy dome overlay available.

brief.label: Regulatory + disclosure envelope
items: RoHS 3 (EU 2015/863) + REACH SVHC screen on the ABS resin, PVC face, CMYK ink, laser-engrave layer and any epoxy-dome overlay.

FCC Part 15.225 (13.56 MHz) and §15.209 (125 kHz passive) + RED 2014/53/EU + ISED RSS-210 / RSS-GEN — the token is a passive transponder paired with a reader / dispenser that carries the FCC / ISED / CE ID.
California Prop 65 declaration on the California-distributed consumer-facing SKUs; EN 71-3 migration of certain elements for children's-channel novelty-token variants.

brief.label: Lifecycle + end-of-life
items: Typical programme life — 3-5 years under daily recirculation; chip EEPROM rated for tens of thousands of write cycles, outlasting the mechanical ABS housing fatigue life.
UID / stored-value-file sanitisation per NIST SP 800-88 Rev. 1 at retirement — destroy the chip before the housing enters the WEEE / recycling stream.
ABS + PVC stream recycled per WEEE Directive 2012/19/EU Annex VII; halogen-free ABS grade on request for corporate CDP / Higg Index sustainability reporting.

heroPoints: Disc-format ABS / PVC / epoxy token at ±0.1 mm diameter tolerance across 13-50 mm — the token-dispenser / coin-slot / arcade-bucket form validated per IEC 60068-2-32 Ea 1.0 m drop at 1,000 cycles without housing crack or chip-read failure.

125 kHz LF (EM4100 / EM4305 / T5577) + 13.56 MHz HF (NTAG 213-216 / NTAG 424 DNA / MIFARE Classic / Plus SE / DESFire EV3) chip library on a single housing SKU — pick the chip per dispenser reader, not the other way around.

MIFARE DESFire EV3 AES-128 stored-value file + NTAG 424 DNA SUN / CMAC anti-counterfeit — the correct chip posture for casino-chip / parking-credit / locker-token / gaming-token programmes where CRYPTO-1 MIFARE Classic cannot defend the monetary value.

sections.title: Why the disc-format token earns its place in the catalogue alongside the coin-keyfob
bullets: No-hole disc vs key-ring coin — the token is designed to be dropped into a mechanical coin-slot, dispenser barrel or arcade collection bucket, recirculate through a bucket-drop cycle, and be collected and redistributed; the keyring-holed rfid-coin-keyfob is a different form factor anchored to the user's keychain.

±0.1 mm diameter tolerance is the make-or-break spec — a laundry-token supplier that delivers a 20 mm ± 0.5 mm batch against a 19 mm coin-acceptor causes 100 % jamming; Proud Tek dispatches a 5-unit physical sample against the operator's specific acceptor dimension before freezing the production run.

1.0 m drop onto steel plate at 1,000 cycles per IEC 60068-2-32 Ea is the gaming / arcade fatigue bar; ABS shells that crack at 500 cycles expose the chip and generate read-failure tickets that are almost always mistaken for chip faults, not housing faults.

Casino-chip audit — per-chip laser-engraved sequential numbering + NTAG 424 DNA SUN / DESFire EV3 AES-128 together enable a gaming-commission-grade reconciliation at scale (100,000 chips walked across an RFID reader in under 4 hours).

Stored-value programmes must specify MIFARE DESFire EV3 AES-128 or NTAG 424 DNA SUN — CRYPTO-1 MIFARE Classic is trivially counterfeited with off-the-shelf tooling per Garcia et al. 2008, and any monetary-value rollout on Classic carries a direct counterfeit-token fraud liability.

sections.title: LF vs HF — picking the chip from the dispenser, not the catalogue
bullets: LF 125 kHz (EM4100 read-only, EM4305 re-writable, T5577 multi-protocol) — for laundry / locker / legacy HID-Prox dispenser reader estates; 50-60 % of North-American commercial-laundry machines still use LF readers per industry benchmarks.

HF 13.56 MHz (NTAG 213 / 215 / 216) — for NFC-Forum phone-tappable tokens; loyalty / promotional / social-sharing envelopes where the end user taps the token to their phone for URL / vCard / points-credit.
HF 13.56 MHz (MIFARE Plus SE / DESFire EV3) — for AES-128 access-control token credentials; boutique-fitness locker / members-club / corporate-parking envelopes.
HF 13.56 MHz (NTAG 424 DNA) — for tap-authenticated / anti-counterfeit / gaming-chip envelopes with SUN + CMAC replay-protection per NIST SP 800-38B.

Chip-frequency mismatch against the dispenser is the single biggest order-failure mode — Proud Tek cross-references the dispenser brand + model against the compatibility matrix and confirms the chip in the order acknowledgement before tooling.

sections.title: Where RFID coin tags earn their place in operator programmes
bullets: University / multi-family housing laundry — 3,000-50,000 LF or HF tokens across 15-500 machines; per-token UID lookup against a student-ID or rent-ledger account; zero cash-handling at the laundry machine.
Gaming entertainment / arcade / amusement park — HF MIFARE Classic 1K (low-security arcade envelope) or HF NTAG 213 (phone-tappable promotional tokens) across 5,000-500,000 tokens per venue.

Casino — NTAG 424 DNA SUN + laser-engraved sequential chip number across 40 mm epoxy-dome or ABS disc; per-chip gaming-commission audit; anti-counterfeit posture versus the CRYPTO-1-attackable MIFARE Classic alternative.
Locker systems — 20 / 25 mm ABS token as locker key in gym / pool / changing-room venues; DESFire EV3 AES-128 access credential; lost-token revocation at the PACS head-end.
Parking — 30 mm ABS token as prepaid parking credit dispensed by kiosk; DESFire EV3 stored-value file; backend-authoritative balance with tamper-evident counter for reconciliation.
Promotional giveaway / collectible — 40 / 50 mm epoxy-dome disc with NTAG 213 URL to the campaign landing page; limited-edition laser-engraved serial number becomes the keepsake.

dataHighlight.heading: Coin-slot jam service-call reduction after switching from ± 0.5 mm tolerance tokens to ± 0.1 mm diameter-confirmed tokens
dataHighlight.text: A university laundry facility operating 15 commercial washers and 15 dryers reported 8-12 coin-jam service calls per month with an off-spec ± 0.5 mm tolerance token programme from a prior supplier — each service call cost 45-90 minutes of downtime plus a technician callout. After switching to Proud Tek's ± 0.1 mm dimensional-check token with a 5-unit physical-sample validation against the specific Speed Queen coin-acceptor dimension, the facility reported zero coin-jam service calls across an 18-month observation window. The same operator paired this with a cross-campus gaming-venue rollout of 40 mm NTAG 424 DNA chips where the per-chip laser-engraved sequential number enabled a full annual audit reconciliation of 100,000+ chips against the gaming-commission database in 4 hours, versus 3 days of manual counting with unmarked prior-supplier chips.
dataHighlight.source: Proud Tek 18-month multi-venue laundry + gaming-chip deployment review, cross-referenced against Speed Queen / Huebsch commercial-laundry acceptor specifications and American Gaming Association (AGA) 2024 chip-audit benchmark study.

sections.title: How to roll out an RFID coin-tag programme without dimensional or chip-security surprises
bullets: Send the specific coin-acceptor / dispenser / bucket brand + model + dimensional spec to the RFQ — diameter ± 0.1 mm and thickness to match the mechanical profile is the make-or-break spec; a 5-unit physical-sample batch ships before the full production run.

Freeze the chip against the dispenser-reader frequency before artwork — LF 125 kHz vs HF 13.56 MHz vs which HF chip (NTAG 213 / 424 DNA / DESFire EV3 / Classic) is decided from the reader end, not the token catalogue.

For any monetary-value programme (parking credit / stored-value locker / casino chip) specify MIFARE DESFire EV3 or NTAG 424 DNA from the start — CRYPTO-1 MIFARE Classic is a documented counterfeit-fraud liability and migration away is explicit per NXP and BSI guidance.

Laser-engraved sequential numbering per chip is standard (no MOQ upcharge) — this enables per-chip audit reconciliation, lost-chip loss accounting, and gaming-commission-grade chip-to-database matching at scale.

Accelerated drop / tumble validation — specify the IEC 60068-2-32 Ea 1.0 m × 1,000-cycle requirement on the RFQ; housing SKUs that fail at 500 cycles generate misdiagnosed chip-failure tickets and erode programme economics.

items.label: Week 1 — dispenser spec + chip matrix + 5-unit sample
items.text: Freeze the coin-acceptor / dispenser / bucket dimensional spec (diameter ± 0.1 mm, thickness matched to the mechanical profile), the chip against the reader-frequency matrix (LF 125 kHz EM4305 / T5577 vs HF 13.56 MHz NTAG / DESFire EV3 / NTAG 424 DNA), and dispatch a 5-unit physical sample for operator fit-validation before tooling.

items.label: Weeks 2-3 — drop-test + encoding-bench validation
items.text: Run the IEC 60068-2-32 Ea 1.0 m drop at 1,000 cycles on 20-unit housing samples; encode the first pilot batch on the bench; validate reader-read rate (100 % UID + 99.5 %+ NDEF / DESFire session authentication) across the dispenser fleet.

items.label: Weeks 4-6 — production + QC finish-quality audit
items.text: Run the 500-50,000-piece production batch; audit 1 % QC sample against diameter tolerance (±0.1 mm), drop survival (1.0 m × 1,000 cycles), laser-engrave legibility (abrasion-resistance test), and NFC / RFID read rate; reject any batch that fails the finish-quality bar.

items.label: Weeks 7-8 — encoding + logistics + backend wiring
items.text: Pre-encode per-token UID / NDEF URL / DESFire AES-128 session credentials; polybag + bulk-pack per rollout channel; wire the backend authoritative balance + revocation workflow + per-chip audit database; ship to the venue fleet.

items.label: Month 3+ — audit cadence + casino-commission + sustainability reporting
items.text: Operating context extends to multi-family-laundry, gaming-arcade, casino-table-chip, municipal-parking, locker-credit and loyalty-promotional RFID-coin-token programmes — review periodicity, refresh windows and audit obligations vary by vertical and are documented per estate. wire issue / revoke / loss / retirement events into the operator backend audit log; layer the gaming-commission chip-reconciliation report, RoHS 3 + REACH SVHC + California Prop 65 + EN 71-3 evidence pack, and CDP / Higg Index sustainability reporting on top.

faq.question: Will the token fit my specific laundry / dispenser / acceptor coin-slot?
faq.answer: Yes — diameter is manufactured to ± 0.1 mm against the specific coin-acceptor dimension you provide. Send the make + model of the Speed Queen / Huebsch / Dexter / Miele / Electrolux / arcade / parking dispenser at the RFQ stage, and Proud Tek dispatches a 5-unit physical sample for fit-validation before the full production run is frozen. A 20 mm acceptor typically tolerates 19.8-20.2 mm tokens; a 1 mm oversize causes 100 % jamming and is the single biggest cause of unusable-token orders from prior suppliers. Standard stock diameters are 13 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 40 / 50 mm.

faq.question: How durable is the ABS housing under repeated bucket-drop and mechanical-acceptor recirculation?
faq.answer: Proud Tek ABS tokens are drop-tested per IEC 60068-2-32 Ea at 1.0 m onto steel plate across 1,000 cycles without housing crack or chip-read failure. This is the bucket-drop fatigue profile of arcade / gaming / casino recirculation. Shells that crack at 500 cycles expose the chip and generate read-failure tickets that are routinely misdiagnosed as chip faults when the root cause is actually a housing fault. For UL 94 V-0 flammability grade (amusement-park / fire-code-sensitive venues), specify at the RFQ stage — modest cost premium, no lead-time impact.

faq.question: Which chip should I specify for a stored-value token (parking credit, laundry credit, casino chip)?
faq.answer: MIFARE DESFire EV3 with AES-128 mutual authentication + value-file + session keys per NXP AN12343 and key-diversification per NXP AN10922. DESFire EV3 is the correct chip for any monetary-value programme — it supports a tamper-evident value file that prevents balance manipulation, and the authoritative balance lives in your operator backend with the token as the authenticated credential. For anti-counterfeit / per-chip-auditable casino chips, specify NTAG 424 DNA with SUN message + CMAC replay-protection per NIST SP 800-38B. **Do not use MIFARE Classic 1K for stored value** — CRYPTO-1 has been publicly broken since Garcia et al. 2008, and inflated-balance counterfeit tokens can be produced with off-the-shelf tooling. Both NXP and the German BSI recommend migration away from Classic for new monetary-value rollouts.

faq.question: Can I get sequential laser-engraved numbers on each token for audit purposes?
faq.answer: Yes — laser-engraved sequential numbering (combined with venue logo / mint-mark / QR code / barcode at the buyer's option) is standard and carries no MOQ upcharge. The laser mark is abrasion-resistant and chemical-resistant. Sequential numbering is the backbone of the gaming-commission chip audit: a full annual reconciliation of 100,000+ chips against the venue database can be walked across an RFID reader fleet in under 4 hours when every chip carries a unique laser-engraved serial number matched to the NTAG 424 DNA UID or DESFire EV3 application-ID. Sample engravings are provided for approval before the production run is frozen.

faq.question: Are the tokens waterproof for pool / locker / hot-wash environments?
faq.answer: Yes — the ABS housing is ultrasonically welded to IP67 per IEC 60529, and the RFID chip and antenna are fully encapsulated inside the housing. The tokens are rated for continuous immersion in chlorinated pool water, sweat-heavy locker environments, and hot-wash detergent discharge. Tokens recirculate through a typical 3-5 year multi-venue laundry / gaming programme with no degradation of read performance. For hydrocarbon / solvent exposure (industrial laundry or commercial-kitchen environments) specify an epoxy-overmoulded variant.

faq.question: What are typical MOQs, lead times, and pricing tiers?
faq.answer: Standard ABS / PVC stock shapes (13 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 40 / 50 mm round in stock colours): MOQ 500, lead time 10-15 business days. Custom diameters to ± 0.1 mm: MOQ 1,000, lead time 15-20 business days. Custom epoxy dome + full-colour CMYK print: MOQ 500, lead time 12-18 business days. Laser-engraved sequential numbering: no MOQ upcharge, adds 2-3 days. Pricing varies with chip (EM4100 lowest / NTAG 213 low / MIFARE Classic 1K mid / DESFire EV3 + NTAG 424 DNA premium) and finish; a representative 1,000-unit 25 mm ABS coin with NTAG 213 and single-colour print sits in the sub-$1 per-unit range for quantity-break pricing.
